query: Prepare a one-page briefing for a meeting with Nvidia on 17 November 2026. Cover what changed in the last 30 days (news, launches, hires, deals), cite a source URL for every fact, and end with three open questions to ask.
briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: NVIDIA, 17 November 2026

**Window:** roughly 18 October to 17 November 2026. Sources are limited to the search results provided.

## Leadership and governance

- Jensen Huang resigned as chairman, CEO, and director, effective immediately. Colette Kress, CFO since September 2013, is interim CEO and remains CFO until a successor is chosen (https://meteoraweb.com/en/news/nvidia-jensen-huang-steps-down-as-ceo). The company announced the transition on 12 November (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition).
- The board has started a search and will consider internal and external candidates (https://meteoraweb.com/en/news/nvidia-jensen-huang-steps-down-as-ceo).
- The board's 8 November statement expressed confidence in Huang and promised updates "as appropriate" (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-nvidia-board-of-directors). Independent board members issued a separate statement on 10 November (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition).
- The New York Times reports that Huang admitted an affair, that the board said it would investigate, and that the reporting also describes a relationship with Kimberly Powell, NVIDIA's VP of health care, who reports to him (https://www.nytimes.com/live/2026/11/12/business/nvidia-jensen-huang-resigns).
- Wired, as reported by Mezha, says NVIDIA hired a crisis PR firm at least a year before Huang acknowledged the affair (https://mezha.net/eng/news/mezha-cbe54f11b05c0e59be5a05db_wired-_nvidia_hired). I could only see the headline, not the article body.

## Launches and partnerships

- NVIDIA, Rebellions and SK Telecom announced a collaboration on sovereign AI infrastructure using NVLink Fusion, dated 8 November (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition, news listing).
- An AWS and NVIDIA announcement describes AWS deploying 2 million additional Blackwell Ultra, Rubin and Rubin Ultra GPUs across 2027 and 2028 (https://shattered.io/gpu-vs-tpu-vs-npu-ai-chip-camps-compared-2026).
- Rubin reportedly moved into production shipments in the second half of 2026 (https://shattered.io/gpu-vs-tpu-vs-npu-ai-chip-camps-compared-2026).

## Deals

- A wire item dated 15 November says a company "has agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion," with closing expected next quarter (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced). **The item does not name NVIDIA. Treat it as unverified until confirmed.**
- NVIDIA's acquisition list shows Hugging Face (1 Aug 2026, $12.90B), Kumo.AI (1 Jun 2026, $400M), and Illumex (1 Feb 2026, $60M) (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/TXRhn2TKUD7t). All fall outside the 30-day window.

## Hires

- I found no external executive hires in the window. The only leadership change is the interim CEO appointment above.

## Timing

- NVIDIA is scheduled to release quarterly results around 4:20 p.m. ET on Tuesday, 17 November, with the earnings call at 5 p.m. ET. It will be the first call since Huang's exit (https://mashable.com/tech/jensen-huang-affairs-nvidia-resignation-timeline). This is the same day as the meeting.

## Open questions

1. What is the timeline and selection process for a permanent CEO, and how will the interim period affect strategic decisions?
2. How will the board's investigation and the reported PR-firm hiring affect governance, disclosure, and partner confidence?
3. Given the Rubin production ramp and the AWS 2027–2028 commitment, what supply and delivery milestones should we plan around, and does today's earnings update change them?
